title: Три варианта судьбы  (Three Versions of Fate)

scenes.title: Debate Over the Son's Name
scenes.summary: Max reflects on fateful choices while Nastya and Kostya argue at the bar over unusual names for their future son.

scenes.title: Kuzma or Dmitry?
scenes.summary: Kostya suggests naming their baby Dmitry instead of Kuzma and asks Max to settle the argument.

scenes.title: First Version: Max's Anger
scenes.summary: Max snaps that the name Dmitry annoys him and then boldly tells Nagiyev that Vika is not going anywhere with him.

scenes.title: Everyone Must Know Their Place
scenes.summary: Max insists he and Vika belong together, while Nagiyev mocks him and tells him to know his place.

scenes.title: A Cockroach in the Fricassee
scenes.summary: While Max and Vika flee in a car outside, Chef Barinov and Katya argue over a cockroach found in a guest's dish.

scenes.title: Lyova's School Secret
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya clash over who has the right to name their baby, while Chef Barinov teases Lyova about a school memory.

scenes.title: Locked in Storage and Back to the Start
scenes.summary: Max locks Nagiyev inside the storage room, and the story rewinds to the moment Kostya asks Max about the baby's name.

scenes.title: Second Version: Taxi Chase
scenes.summary: Lyova again reports the cockroach to Chef Barinov, while outside Nagiyev hires a driver to chase down his own car.

scenes.title: The Journalist and the Cockroach
scenes.summary: A journalist threatens to photograph the cockroach in his dish and ruin Claude Monet's reputation across Moscow.

scenes.title: Fried Onion and a Red Light
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov eats the cockroach calling it fried onion, while Nagiyev's driver refuses to run a red light during the chase.

scenes.title: Kostya and Nastya's Quarrel
scenes.summary: Nagiyev mocks his law-student driver, and Kostya accidentally makes Nastya cry by saying he rejects Kuzma.

scenes.title: Max's Plan and a Pill for the Chef
scenes.summary: Max tells Kostya to get rid of Nagiyev's car and keep Vika at the apartment, while Katya tends to Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: The Chase and a New Attempt
scenes.summary: Max misunderstands Kostya comforting Vika, and when Vika runs out into traffic, Max races after her.

scenes.title: Simple Truths of Life
scenes.summary: Max reflects on life's most important truths—love, gratitude, and friendship—as the timeline rewinds a third time.

scenes.title: Third Version: Calling from the Chef's Phone
scenes.summary: Max lures Nagiyev away from his car by faking an emergency in the kitchen, leaving Nagiyev furious when he finds Barinov healthy.

scenes.title: Confession in the Car
scenes.summary: In the car, Max sincerely tells Vika that he was wrong and confesses that he truly loves her.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Tastes the 'Fried Onion'
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov convinces Nagiyev to eat the cockroach by calling it fried onion, just before Max bumps Nagiyev's car outside.

scenes.title: A Wrecked Car and a Broken Heart
scenes.summary: Max and Vika tell Nagiyev they want to be together, and a heartbroken Nagiyev vows to blacklist them across Moscow.

scenes.title: A Future Next Door to Rodion Sergeyevich
scenes.summary: In Max's vision of the future, an exhausted Vika and Max live in poverty after being blacklisted by Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Letting Go for Happiness
scenes.summary: Returning to reality at the bar, Max realizes that to make Vika happy he must let her go with Nagiyev.
